memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Review of asthma control and routine check-up.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/78 mmHg, weight 62 kg, height 158 cm, BMI 24.8 (overweight). Respiratory exam: mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally, good air entry.
IMPRESSION: Asthma, intermittent symptoms. Overweight per Asian cut‑offs. Advised on balanced diet and regular walking. Fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar ordered for baseline cardiovascular risk.
ARRANGEMENTS: Salbutamol MDI 2 puffs SOS, Budesonide‑Formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD, Montelukast 10 mg HS. Spirometry with reversibility and Asthma Control Test scheduled. Return if: worsening wheeze, night awakenings >2/week, exercise limitation, fever >39°C, or any chest pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up on lipid and glucose results; asthma stable.
EXAMINATION: BP 119/76 mmHg, weight 61.5 kg, BMI 24.6 (overweight). No wheeze, good aeration.
IMPRESSION: Lipids and glucose within target. Asthma well‑controlled. Continue current inhaled therapy; reinforce weight‑management advice (diet, 30 min brisk walk daily).
ARRANGEMENTS: No medication change. Spirometry scheduled for next visit. Return if: increased reliever use, nocturnal symptoms, fever >39°C, breathlessness at rest, or chest tightness.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Asthma review and influenza vaccination.
EXAMINATION: BP 121/77 mmHg, weight 61 kg, BMI 24.4 (overweight). Mild intermittent wheeze on forced expiration.
IMPRESSION: Asthma controlled. Overweight – advise reduced refined carbs, increase vegetable intake, aim for 5 000 steps/day. Annual fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar ordered.
ARRANGEMENTS: Influenza vaccine (0.5 mL IM) given today 2025‑10‑02. Continue salbutamol SOS, budesonide‑formoterol BD, montelukast HS. Return if: peak flow drop >20%, worsening cough, fever >39°C, haemoptysis, or chest pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine asthma check; review of lipids and glucose.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/75 mmHg, weight 60.8 kg, BMI 24.3 (overweight). Chest clear.
IMPRESSION: Metabolic parameters stable. Asthma asymptomatic. Continue current regimen; encourage strength training twice weekly.
ARRANGEMENTS: No prescription change. Spirometry with reversibility planned for spring. Return if: increased night symptoms, exercise intolerance, fever >39°C, blood in sputum, or sudden dyspnea.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: Pre‑bronchodilator FEV1 2.85 L (88% predicted), FVC 3.40 L (92% predicted), FEV1/FVC 84%. Post‑salbutamol FEV1 3.10 L (96% predicted), increase 8.8% and 0.25 L (>12% and >200 mL significant). Asthma Control Test score 22/25 (well controlled).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Review of spirometry results; asthma control.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/74 mmHg, weight 60.5 kg, BMI 24.2 (overweight). No wheeze.
IMPRESSION: Spirometry shows reversible airflow obstruction consistent with asthma; post‑bronchodilator improvement >12% confirms diagnosis. Asthma well controlled per ACT. Continue current therapy; remind about inhaler technique.
ARRANGEMENTS: No medication adjustment. Return if: daytime symptoms >2/week, night waking, reliever use >2 × /week, fever >39°C, or chest pain.
